reason: In a normal week I'm not cramming yet, and my classmates already drop real past midterms into our Discord chat. Even at $3.99 with a paused clock, I've seen AI mess up quant math too many times to rely on generated remix problems I'd still have to double-check line by line.
objection: Calling it a 'Dual-Model Math Verifier' still sounds like two AIs checking each other rather than exact math, and if a subscript or worked step is wrong during a 48-hour cram, getting a $3.99 refund afterward doesn't undo losing points on the exam.
would_change_my_mind: Running the free 5-question preview right before a real midterm on my professor's hardest past-exam PDF and seeing deterministic math verification—not just two AI models—get every subscript, sign, and calculation step right.
